skill.name: postgresql-development-cloudbase
skill.description: Guides CloudBase PostgreSQL development for web apps, including PG mode setup, schema management, app.rdb() CRUD, RLS policies, auth sessions, PG storage, and HTTP API fallback.
skill.summary: Build and verify CloudBase PostgreSQL apps with correct SDK, auth, RLS, storage, and migration workflows.
skill.author: tencentcloudbase

content.value_statement: CloudBase PG apps need correct SDK, schema, auth, RLS, and storage setup. This skill guides agents through safe PostgreSQL workflows and verification.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when a CloudBase task should use PostgreSQL mode instead of NoSQL or MySQL tooling.
Guides schema setup with queryPgDatabase and managePgDatabase, including migrations and verification steps.
Provides CloudBase JS SDK v3 app.rdb() CRUD, RPC, query, and storage patterns.
Explains CloudBase auth roles, GRANT statements, RLS policies, and auth.uid() ownership checks.
Documents PG HTTP API fallback paths and troubleshooting for SDK, RLS, and storage failures.
limitations: Focused on CloudBase PostgreSQL and does not replace general PostgreSQL administration guidance.
Requires access to the target CloudBase environment and tools for real schema or permission checks.
Cannot create storage buckets or users unless the active tooling exposes a trusted management surface.
HTTP fallback examples must be verified against current CloudBase OpenAPI documentation before use.

use_cases.title: Implement PG-backed web CRUD
use_cases.description: Build login, list, create, edit, and delete flows using CloudBase JS SDK v3 and app.rdb().

use_cases.title: Design secure table access
use_cases.description: Create tables, grants, and RLS policies that match CloudBase authenticated user sessions.

use_cases.title: Debug CloudBase PG failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose SDK version issues, denied RLS access, missing sequence grants, and PG storage errors.

prompt_templates.title: Start a PG app
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new CloudBase PG web feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the CloudBase PostgreSQL skill to plan a small web CRUD feature. Confirm PG mode, auth needs, tables, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add browser CRUD
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate implementation with the CloudBase JS SDK.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me implement CloudBase PG browser CRUD with app.rdb(). Use auth.getSession() for login state and include build and browser checks.

prompt_templates.title: Repair RLS access
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting for denied reads or writes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my CloudBase PG RLS failure. Check GRANT, sequence access, auth.uid() policies, and whether the browser session matches row ownership.

prompt_templates.title: Review production readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before shipping a PG-backed app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this CloudBase PostgreSQL app for production readiness. Check schema compatibility, RLS boundaries, storage buckets, HTTP fallback use, and verification evidence.

output_examples.input: Create a CloudBase PG article manager with username login and cover image uploads.
output_examples.output: A focused implementation plan covering PG mode checks, table setup, RLS policies, SDK CRUD, storage bucket requirements, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: The browser can log in, but inserts fail with a permission error.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting path that checks table grants, sequence grants, RLS policy expressions, session user identity, and role-specific testing.

output_examples.input: The app uses raw HTTP because app.rdb() is unavailable.
output_examples.output: A fallback review that verifies SDK version, OpenAPI endpoint shape, auth header meaning, and whether API keys stay outside browser code.

best_practices: Confirm the CloudBase environment has PostgreSQL before writing PG-specific code.
Use auth.getSession() and database defaults such as auth.uid() for ownership checks.
Verify schema, grants, RLS policies, build output, browser flows, and database rows before completion.
anti_patterns: Using CloudBase NoSQL APIs for business data that must live in PostgreSQL.
Exposing API Key or service_role credentials in browser code.
Treating UI button hiding as authorization instead of enforcing GRANT and RLS rules.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for CloudBase PG mode, app.rdb(), queryPgDatabase, managePgDatabase, RLS, PG storage, or PostgreSQL-backed web apps.

faq.question: Does it support CloudBase NoSQL?
faq.answer: It explains when NoSQL is the wrong path, but it focuses on PostgreSQL mode and PG-backed business data.

faq.question: Can it write secure RLS policies?
faq.answer: It provides policy patterns and verification steps, but the final policies must be tested with real authenticated sessions.

faq.question: Can browser code use a service role?
faq.answer: No. API Key and service_role credentials must stay in backend or trusted tooling because they bypass RLS.

faq.question: Does it create PG storage buckets?
faq.answer: It explains bucket requirements and RLS setup. Bucket creation depends on available management tools or the CloudBase console.

faq.question: Can it use raw HTTP APIs?
faq.answer: Yes, but only as a fallback after verifying CloudBase OpenAPI details and the correct authentication model.
